newsitem.title: UK: Bass bounces after positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: Bass bounces after positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in brewing-to-hotels group Bass Plc rose in pre-market trade on Friday after positive press comment on the stock.
Bass shares were up 11-1/2p at 796-1/2 by 0722 GMT, rebounding from Thursday's four-month low of 782p -- some 11 percent below its end-January peak.

The Financial Times Lex column said the recent sell-off in Bass "looks overdone" and that if its proposed acquisition of Carlsberg-Tetley is blocked "Bass still gets C-T's 1997 profits, and hands back a crippled competitor."

It said the sector is trading at a discount on the basis of prospective earnings but is growing more quickly than the market as a whole, adding that hotels, restaurants, pubs and betting shops all remain buyant.
Others in the sector also rose, with Whitbread Plc up 5-1/2p at 766-1/2 and Scottish & Newcastle Plc up 6p at 666-1/2. Allied Domecq Plc was up 2p at 430.
